fusions.name: Scrabble of Chips
fusions.desc: Flings 5 chips of gravel at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Tunnelling Bite
fusions.desc: A bite of packed grit that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Rubble Pack
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a pack of rubble-rats for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Dug-In Survivor
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 5 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
